message_index_convention: 0-based native row.trajectory array; raw file lines are 1-based
review_scope: Manual static review of issue triggers, final production model_patch, actual native production edit arguments and tool observations for 16 train tasks / 24 native episodes. Source commands were read as data and never executed. No local task verification, target replay, state restoration, pair creation or GPU use.
limitations: All source user prompts contain a staged scaffold that requests test creation; it conflicts with the current project workflow and must not be copied into target cold-start prompts.
Publisher resolved flags are provenance, not local verified outcomes. Source script PASS, exit=0 and actual task validation are distinct.

Source patches often include untracked test/reproduce/debug/issue/TASKS files; streamlink and graphblas change existing tests. Keep raw evidence but recollect clean target episodes before positive agent supervision.
Source trace failure followed by recovery is not a restored-state counterfactual. No environment states, remaining budgets or behavior logprobs were invented.
This seed has only one strong R4 task and no grounded R1/R2/R3/R5 primary coverage; do not balance counts by keyword labels.
Core patch/edit correspondence is static, not reconstructed final filesystem byte identity; any unexamined shell mutation may require further review.

trigger.summary: Call Variable.diff(dim=x) when constructing consecutive-difference constraints for five symbolic optimization variables.

base_wrong_behavior.summary: Issue reports wrong optimization values; actual native reproduction also exposes AttributeError because Variable has no diff, while the underlying DataArray numeric label diff would subtract integer labels rather than symbolic variables.

causal_change.summary: Build self - self.shift({dim:1}) as a symbolic LinearExpression and remove the invalid first position; this preserves variable identities and coefficients instead of treating variable labels as numeric values.

discriminating_observation.summary: Native solver observes [0,1,2,3,4] for the exact issue after edits; another attempt merely wraps DataArray.diff/differentiate and has publisher unresolved. These separate attempts are not a same-state preference pair.
